verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a hosted MCP server enabling natural-language queries (e.g., 'What's my balance today?') through connected AI agents, confirmed live via OAuth-gated probe and documented tool list. However, the MCP is strictly read-only (31 get/list tools, zero write/send actions per probe-5), so natural-language operation cannot perform payments, transfers, or invoicing — the core 'operate' actions still require the CLI or dashboard. Missing for 10: natural-language support for write/transactional actions, first-party in-app chat/NL interface, and independent user reports of actually using NL commands successfully.
